what: A cascade has to stop somewhere, so we made it stop. No document we hold establishes a legal minimum for any of these programs.
evidence: Between the FY26 and FY27 budgets the district cut ten special education lines totalling $224,049 — including an entire Elementary School Psychologist, from $98,784 to nothing.
implication: Cutting a service that is still owed does not save the money. It moves the cost somewhere a budget cannot see it.
